response.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS c, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS r FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0), pa AS (SELECT c, player_id, AVG(r) AS a FROM v GROUP BY c, player_id), ca AS (SELECT c, AVG(a) AS avg_ratio FROM pa GROUP BY c) SELECT c AS death_country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM ca) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM ca;

assumptions.assumption: 'Award-vote record' means player_award_vote, the only vote table with a foreign key to player. manager_award_vote is not included.
A blank death country covers both NULL and empty string, combined into one group ('').
Ratios that can't be computed are those with NULL points_won, NULL points_max, or points_max = 0. These rows are skipped.
player.player_id is unique, so the join does not duplicate votes.

alternatives.interpretation: Include both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote records (manager votes also carry player_id), matched to player.
alternatives.sql: WITH allv AS (SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote), v AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS c, CAST(a.points_won AS REAL) / a.points_max AS r FROM allv a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.points_won IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max <> 0), pa AS (SELECT c, player_id, AVG(r) AS a FROM v GROUP BY c, player_id), ca AS (SELECT c, AVG(a) AS avg_ratio FROM pa GROUP BY c) SELECT c AS death_country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM ca) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM ca;
